security_audit.summary: All 31 static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown fences, inline code, URLs, and relative documentation links. A separate privacy ambiguity is present because the skill requests seed rows while also prohibiting raw PII output.

remediation.issue: The requested seed-row output can conflict with the prohibition against exposing raw customer PII.
remediation.suggestion: Require aggregation or approved irreversible hashing, specify an allowlist of output fields, and never write row-level customer records to memory.

content.value_statement: Customer exports are difficult to convert into consistent advertising audiences. This skill creates seed, lookalike, exclusion, and funnel-stage segment plans.
actual_capabilities: Profiles available customer, CRM, and GA4 export columns.
Defines seed audiences from customer traits and behaviors.
Ranks value-based lookalike seeds using a supplied value field.
Creates customer, purchaser, refund, and bad-fit suppression segments.
Maps platform-neutral audiences to cold, warm, and hot funnel stages.
Flags missing inputs instead of inventing unsupported segment criteria.
limitations: Requires a user-provided customer, CRM, or GA4 export.
Does not build campaigns, ad groups, or keyword match types.
Does not upload audiences without a separate optional connector.
Cannot create value-based seeds when the export lacks a value field.

use_cases.title: Prepare Prospecting Audiences
use_cases.description: Create reusable seed and lookalike definitions from high-value customer traits.

use_cases.title: Reduce Wasted Advertising Spend
use_cases.description: Define suppression windows for customers, recent purchasers, refunds, and unqualified leads.

use_cases.title: Standardize Cross-Platform Segments
use_cases.description: Map GA4 audiences to shared funnel stages for Google, Meta, and other platforms.

prompt_templates.title: Create Basic Segments
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my customer CSV to define seed and exclusion audiences for Meta. Use aggregate descriptions and flag missing columns.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs a first segmentation plan.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Value Seed
prompt_templates.prompt: Rank customers by [value field] and define a lookalike seed. State seed size, required columns, and privacy safeguards.
prompt_templates.scenario: A marketer has customer value data.

prompt_templates.title: Map Funnel Audiences
prompt_templates.prompt: Map these GA4 audiences across cold, warm, and hot stages for Google and Meta. Include retargeting windows and suppression rules.
prompt_templates.scenario: A team needs consistent cross-platform targeting.

prompt_templates.title: Design an Advanced Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a platform-neutral segmentation plan for [goal] using [export columns]. Compare seed quality, exclusions, funnel stages, and ROAS Audience relevance.
prompt_templates.scenario: An analyst needs a complete audience strategy.

output_examples.input: A customer export contains lifetime value, last purchase date, plan, and refund status.
output: Seed: high-value active customers, defined by the supplied lifetime value field.
Exclusion: purchasers from the last 30 days.
Suppression: refunded customers and unqualified plans.

output_examples.input: A GA4 export contains pricing visits, product views, and completed purchases.
output: Cold: qualified visitors without product engagement.
Warm: recent product viewers, excluding customers.
Hot: pricing visitors, excluding recent purchasers.

best_practices: Use aggregate or approved hashed values and remove direct identifiers before analysis.
Tie every segment rule to a documented export column.
State lookback windows, seed sizes, and suppression logic explicitly.
anti_patterns: Do not paste unnecessary emails, phone numbers, or complete customer records.
Do not invent value, intent, or fit signals that are absent from the export.
Do not mix audience planning with campaign structure or keyword selection.

faq.question: What input does this skill require?
faq.answer: Provide a customer, CRM, or GA4 export with relevant traits, values, dates, or behavior columns.

faq.question: Does it upload audiences to advertising platforms?
faq.answer: No. It creates audience definitions. Uploading requires a separate optional connector or manual platform workflow.

faq.question: Can it build lookalike audiences?
faq.answer: It defines and ranks first-party seed audiences. Advertising platforms perform the actual lookalike expansion.

faq.question: How does it protect personal data?
faq.answer: Use aggregate or approved hashed data, remove direct identifiers, and avoid saving row-level customer records.

faq.question: Which advertising platforms are supported?
faq.answer: The output is platform-neutral and can guide Google, Meta, and other platforms that support comparable audience types.

faq.question: What happens when required columns are missing?
faq.answer: The skill marks affected segments as needing input instead of guessing unsupported criteria.
